boundary_condition: This applies only to flight cabin or seating-class selection; it does not imply a preferred airline, route, travel date, departure time, or fare budget.
condition: When booking or searching for flights and a cabin or seating class is needed, if no trip-specific upgrade is requested.
default_action: Default the flight cabin search to coach/economy seating.
exception_condition: If the user explicitly asks for or accepts a different cabin such as premium economy, business, or first class for the current trip, use that requested cabin instead of coach/economy.
name: Prefers coach/economy cabin for flights
rationale: Across four independent flight-task instruction_ids, the cited users select or prefer the seating class transcribed as “couch,” which is plausibly the coach/economy cabin in the flight_search.seating_class annotation. This supports a controlled synthetic-user default for coach/economy seating when cabin class is otherwise unspecified, without treating the speakers as one real user.

source_evidence.contribution: User states a seating-class preference: “I'd like morning flight and I would hope for the couch,” with “couch” annotated as flight_search.seating_class.
